mora_timing.isochrony: Each mora occupies an approximately equal duration in time (~120-150ms).

special_morae.hatsuon_moraic_nasal: ん (N): counts as 1 full mora (e.g. に・ほ・ん = 3 morae).
special_morae.sokuon_geminate_stop: っ (Q): counts as 1 full mora (e.g. き・っ・て = 3 morae).
special_morae.chouon_long_vowel: ー / 長音 (R): counts as 1 full mora (e.g. コ・ー・ヒ・ー = 4 morae).

pitch_accent.nature: Lexical pitch accent (High vs Low pitch melody), distinctly different from Chinese tone or English stress accent.

sound_inventory.vowel_devoicing: High vowels /i/ and /u/ become unvoiced [i̥], [ɯ̥] when occurring between voiceless consonants (/k/, /s/, /t/, /h/, /p/) or utterance-finally after a voiceless consonant (e.g. です -> [desɯ̥], 学生 -> [gakɯ̥seː]).

loanword_phonology.vowel_insertion: Epenthetic vowels /u/ and /o/ are inserted to break up English/foreign consonant clusters (e.g., strike -> s[u]t[o]raik[u] ストライク).

phonemic_mapping.l_and_r: Both map to Japanese /ɾ/ (e.g., light and right both become ライト).
phonemic_mapping.v: Maps to /b/ (e.g., violin -> バイオリン), or modern ヴ (ヴァイオリン).
